name: Natalia Connolly
bio: I bring deep expertise in artificial intelligence and machine learning to complex business problems. A physicist by training (PhD in High Energy Physics), I've spent 15+ years as a data science and AI executive, building and scaling technical teams across management consulting, retail and fintech. I've worked at both ends of the spectrum -  from Fortune 500 enterprises  navigating data governance and AI risk, to early-stage startups deploying ML at scale on limited resources.  Now at AlixPartners as Director of Performance, I both advise C-suite clients and architect production AI workflows at scale. Claude Certified Architect (2026).

sessions.title: Claude Code, Financial Analyst: Turning a Coding Agent Loose on Governed Enterprise Data
